import sys

MD = 998244353

def power(a, k):
    if k == 0:
        return 1
    p = power(a, k >> 1)
    p = p * p % MD
    if (k & 1) == 1:
        p = p * a % MD
    return p

def ch(ff, gg, n, k):
    return ff[n] * gg[k] % MD * gg[n - k] % MD

def main():
    input_data = sys.stdin.read().strip().split()
    n = int(input_data[0])
    k_ = int(input_data[1])
    if k_ >= n:
        print(0)
        return
    c = n - k_
    ff = [0] * (n + n)
    gg = [0] * (n + n)
    f = 1
    for i in range(n + n):
        gg[i] = power(ff[i] = f, MD - 2)
        f = (f * (i + 1)) % MD
    ans = 0
    for a in range(1, c + 1):
        x = power(a, n) * ch(ff, gg, c, a) % MD
        ans += (0 if a % 2 == 0 else -1) * x
    ans %= MD
    ans = ans * ch(ff, gg, n, c) % MD
    if k_ > 0:
        ans = ans * 2 % MD
    print(ans)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
